stories.title: Israeli settlers shoot and wound two Palestinians east of Hebron
stories.summary: Israeli settlers shoot and wound two Palestinians east of Hebron Israeli settlers shot and wounded two Palestinians in Bani Na’im, east of Hebron in the occupied West Bank on Friday evening, the Wafa news agency reported, citing the Palestine Red Crescent Society. Red Crescent crews treated the two men and transferred them to hospital after settlers opened fire in the town’s al-Edisa area. One man was shot in the head and back, while the other was wounded in the back.
